thought.text: The stack is up. `cms`/`app` are 502 only because dev servers were skipped (`--detach`). Let me verify the backend health endpoint and API.

reasoning_content:
The proxy works. cms/app return 502 because dev servers aren't started (--detach). api returns 404 for `/` but we should hit the health endpoint. Let me check the health endpoint. Also let's verify by hitting /health and the API's actuator.

The 404 on api/ is because `/` isn't a mapped route. Let me check /health and /actuator/health.

action.command:
for path in /health /actuator/health /v3/api-docs /swagger-ui/index.html; do
 code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --resolve "api.urbo.localhost:80:127.0.0.1" "http://api.urbo.localhost$path")
 echo "api$path -> $code"
done
echo "--- health body ---"
curl -sS --resolve "api.urbo.localhost:80:127.0.0.1" "http://api.urbo.localhost/health"; echo
echo "--- meili ---"
curl -sS --resolve "meilisearch.urbo.localhost:80:127.0.0.1" "http://meilisearch.urbo.localhost/health"; echo
echo "--- keycloak realm ---"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --resolve "keycloak.urbo.localhost:80:127.0.0.1" "http://keycloak.urbo.localhost/realms/master"
